text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
Show them the studio, the pool, and then the paddock...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino, what's that?
..."Campus Tour Schedule for Prospective Students"?
Oh, that!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
You were the guide, weren't you, Yukino!
Great job~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, no problem!
This much is nothin'~.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Is only one person coming from Yukino's hometown too?
...Makes you wanna show off your senior side, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (S-Someone from back home!? I had no idea~!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (What does it mean to "act like a senior"...? Maybe giving a little shout-out or offering some encouragement...?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (......N-Nah, that ain't all.)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“――――Sorry to keep you waiting, Yukino-san.
Today, I've got this kind of arrangement for you.”

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(In this big city with a different dialect and culture...
Being able to have a moment of relief has truly saved me.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(If it were me, around this time of year...
Oh, maybe that?)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All right... It's challenge time, Yukino!
E-Even though cooking ain't my strong suit...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even for me... Tenth time's the charm!
This has gotta be delicious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aww, failed again...
...Maybe I tried to cool it down too fast?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you cook is rare, Yukino-san.
Is that milk chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my...? Um, excuse me.
Are we mixing those ingredients with the chocolate?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, that's a taste from my hometown.
I was wonderin' if I could find a way to make it go well with chocolate!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well... I've been struggling quite a bit these past few days, though.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see. Your homeland...
I, too, occasionally think of Germany.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yukino-san. If you'd like, should I lend a hand?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
In that case, umm...
First, about how to melt the chocolate...

And so, Yukino Bijin worked hard on tour preparations
and her disliked cooking...
Finally, the day arrived to meet her future juniors!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Welcome to Tracen Academy!
It's mighty huge, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And today... as your guide, I'll be handin' out homemade Valentine's chocolates!
...Come on now, line right up, y'all~!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's chocolates, huh~?
Tracen Academy really is the best, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Visiting Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of chocolate it is? Let's line up, line up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Now then, where's the girl of the hour... Ah.
There she is.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Here we go, Yukino! Gentle and warm...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, you're the one from back home, right?
...Ehehe, I heard all about ya~.
Everything's so unfamiliar around here, it's kinda scary, ain't it?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Have some too!
I made this chocolate myself, so don't be shy!

text_block_list.name: Country-Bred Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
Rice crackers in chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...See? Looks delicious, don't it~? I mixed in some local rice crackers with the chocolate! It really warms the heart~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Yer takin' on the central leagues, right?
Don't you worry. I'll be waitin' for ya, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Country-Bred Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you... very much!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...I gave it to you, Trainer!
My heart was pounding the whole time...
choice_data_list: She was such a kind and reliable senior!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... In order to be that kind of senior,
I've gotta give it my all in training too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Also... this is your portion, Trainer.
...Please, have some too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~...
Bein' praised that much makes me blush.
I gotta keep workin' hard from here on out too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, speaking of which...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Actually... this one is for you, Trainer.
...Please, have some!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa~... I'm a bit embarrassed...
I gotta keep running hard
to become a senpai everyone can rely on!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Also... this is your portion, Trainer.
...Please, have some too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm glad.
Flash-san and I made so many test batches together!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
It's already evening, are you getting hungry too, Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I accidentally made one too many.
...Please, have some, Trainer!
